resultsProcessor.script: function id(domain, keyId, purpose) { var bytes = context.bytes(); var input = bytes.createFromString(domain + '\u0000' + keyId + '\u0000' + purpose); var digest = bytes.sha256(input); var result = bytes.binaryToHex(digest); bytes.release([input, digest]); return result; } function pairId(keyId, purpose) { return id('opscotch-key-store/pair/v2', keyId, purpose); } function call(step, request) { var response = context.sendToStep(step, JSON.stringify(request)); if (response.isErrored()) throw new Error(response.getAllErrors()[0]); return JSON.parse(response.getBody()); } function expectError(request, expected) { var response = context.sendToStep('key-store-operation', JSON.stringify({ operation: Object.keys(request)[0], ...request[Object.keys(request)[0]] })); if (!response.isErrored()) throw new Error('expected key-store rejection'); var errors = response.getAllErrors().join(' '); if (errors.indexOf(expected) < 0) throw new Error('expected integrity error'); if (errors.indexOf('c2VjcmV0') >= 0) throw new Error('key-store error exposed plaintext'); } var keyId = 'service/tampered'; var purpose = 'sign'; var pair = pairId(keyId, purpose); var malformed = { format: 'opscotch-key-store/key-record/v2', recordType: 'public', keyId: keyId, purpose: purpose, pairId: pair, derivation: 'v2', domain: 'opscotch-key-store-public-test', payload: { publicKeyHex: '0011' }, tag: 'tampered', version: 1 }; var created = call('test-storage', { operation: 'putPairIfAbsent', pairId: pair, publicRecordId: id('opscotch-key-store/public/v2', keyId, purpose), secretRecordId: id('opscotch-key-store/secret/v2', keyId, purpose), publicRecord: malformed, secretRecord: { format: 'opscotch-key-store/key-record/v2', recordType: 'secret', keyId: keyId, purpose: purpose, pairId: pair, derivation: 'v2', domain: 'opscotch-key-store-secret-test', payload: {}, tag: 'unused', version: 1 } }); if (created.status !== 'created') throw new Error('expected malformed pair setup'); expectError({ get: { keyId: keyId, purpose: purpose } }, 'key record integrity failure'); context.sendMetric('key-store-record-integrity-pass', 1.0);
